data.raw_text:
[5:10PM] #Apapa_Ajegunle #TrafficUpdate

Vehicular movement from Ojo Road and Otto Wharf is experiencing fast traffic flow. Similarly, movement from Ajeromi Ifelodun through Baale Street to Boundary Bus Stop remains smooth with vehicles moving freely. Around the Boundary Roundabout, traffic is good and without obstruction.

The stretch from Boundary to Arrakan Military Cantonment is also clear and good to go. Along Marine Beach Bus Stop inward Ijora, vehicles are moving at a fast pace, while traffic from Ijora Oloopa through the High Bridge to Total and Danlami up to Area B is flowing freely on both lanes.

Outbound traffic from Apapa, starting from Point Road through Marine Bridge to Iganmu, is also moving steadily without hindrance. There are no impediments reported across the corridor, and officers are on ground at strategic choke points effectively managing the flow of vehicles.

#FollowLASTMA
